name: arabic
description: Claude Code in Arabic: replies and thinking in Arabic, with an optional right-to-left fix for terminals that show Arabic reversed

rtl.title: RTL mode
rtl.description: auto: picks visual for terminals known to show Arabic reversed (VS Code, kitty, Alacritty, Ghostty, WezTerm), native otherwise. native: your terminal shows Arabic itself (Windows Terminal, WezTerm with bidi_enabled, Konsole, GNOME Terminal). visual: switch to this only if Arabic shows reversed or with disconnected letters; the mod then reorders and joins it.

thinking.title: Thinking language
thinking.description: Language Claude reasons in. English can be slightly sharper and cheaper; replies are Arabic either way.
